focus.name: scene-transition-palette-callbacks
focus.purpose: Decode the two callback services embedded immediately before the scene-transition tile-band helper.

relationships.producer: ACTOR_MOVE_TRANSITION_PRESENTATION_LEAD_IN at 0x00120360 pushes both callback addresses through movement opcode 0x91.
relationships.consumer: SceneResource_InitializeTransitionPresentation clears the latch and tests it before SceneResource_RenderTransitionTileBand.
